description: create: group tabs you were given access to. update: rename/recolor/collapse a group. add_tabs / remove_tabs: change membership (you can only add tabs that are already shared with you). move: reposition a group. activate: focus a member and its window. Group-wide changes are refused unless every member of the group is shared with you, and while the user is in control.

browser_instance_id.description: Only needed when several Firefox profiles are connected.

context_id.description: For activate: which member to focus. Omit to focus the active/first shared member.

items.description: Context id from browser_contexts, for example tab:12.

index.description: For move: target position in the window.

request_id.description: Stable id for this logical action. Reuse the SAME id to retry or reconcile it; never reuse it for a different action. Omit to have one generated and returned.

name: browser_group
title: Change tab groups
